content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-ebooks-without-paypal-what-nobody-tells-you-19|selling]] a digital product should be a simple transaction. You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction completes. But for millions of creators, the payment layer is where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-selling-music-online-24|Everything You]] breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-which-architecture-actually-21|COREMERCH guide to sovereign]] commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators-6. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Solana payments represent a blockchain-based solution for digital transactions. Unlike traditional payment platforms that impose hefty fees, Solana's network enables creators to receive payments with minimal costs. For example, while Gumroad takes a significant 10% from each sale, NOWPayments charges only 0.5%. This difference is crucial for creators looking to maximize their earnings from digital products like ebooks or software.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind Solana payments leverages smart contracts and decentralized storage, ensuring secure and instant transactions. When a buyer makes a purchase, the payment is verified on the blockchain without the need for intermediaries. This architecture not only enhances security but also accelerates delivery of digital products. By utilizing platforms like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script alongside NOWPayments, you can automate the delivery process, ensuring your customers receive their purchases immediately.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where traditional payment gateways are unavailable. Whether you're selling ebooks, templates, or courses, Solana payments empower you to set up your own payment infrastructure. This not only increases your earning potential but also fosters independence from restrictive platforms. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you can access all necessary blueprints and templates to launch your own digital storefront, enabling you to thrive in a competitive market.
Retain more earnings with just a 0.5% fee on every sale.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To effectively use Solana payments, you'll need a combination of tools and platforms. Utilizing Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing ensures a seamless experience. You'll store order data using Supabase or Google Sheets, and automate delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This integrated approach not only simplifies the setup but also ensures that you maintain full ownership of your store and customer data.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing the right tools for your digital product store. Create a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages site to host your storefront. Integrate NOWPayments for handling transactions in cryptocurrencies. Set up delivery mechanisms using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, store order data securely with Supabase or Google Sheets. By following these steps, you can quickly establish a powerful online store that operates independently of conventional payment platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using a blockchain payment solution like Solana. Implementing NOWPayments allows you to accept cryptocurrency, which is processed instantly and at a low fee of 0.5%. This helps you retain more revenue and ensures that your customers enjoy a smooth purchasing experience.
Instant delivery of digital products means happier customers.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for a streamlined way to sell digital products without relying on conventional platforms, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This comprehensive package equips you with all the resources needed to create a sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can use Solana payments through NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency for your ebook sales. This method allows you to bypass traditional payment platforms and retain a larger percentage of your earnings.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?
Implementing a self-hosted solution using Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments allows you to sell digital downloads without high platform fees, maximizing your profits on each sale.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, by leveraging Solana payments and automated delivery systems, you can effectively sell templates and fonts directly to your customers without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip.
What are the benefits of using crypto payments for digital products?
Crypto payments offer lower transaction fees and faster processing times, making them an attractive option for digital creators who want to maximize their revenue and streamline sales.
How can I ensure secure transactions when selling digital products?
Utilizing blockchain technology for payments enhances security by eliminating the need for intermediaries, ensuring that transactions are verified directly on the network.
